original_record.question: There are $4$ mirrors facing the inside of a $5\times 7$ rectangle as shown in the figure. A ray of light comes into the inside of a rectangle through $A$ with an angle of $45^o$. When it hits the sides of the rectangle, it bounces off at the same angle, as shown in the diagram. How many times will the ray of light bounce before it reaches any one of the corners $A$, $B$, $C$, $D$? A bounce is a time when the ray hit a mirror and reflects off it.\n<image1>
